title: Pickleball Grandpa Shirt, Dinking Since Retirement, Funny Retirement Gift for Grandpa, Papa or Pops
description:
He retired, bought a paddle, and hasn't been home since. A friendly shirt for grandpas who dink for a living.

Who it's for:
- Grandpas, papas and pops who live at the courts
- Retirement and birthday gifts for pickleball fans
- Father's Day and Christmas shoppers

About the design:
Arched gold 'PICKLEBALL' over a big cream 'GRANDPA', with paddles and a ball, plus a lime 'Dinking since retirement' line. Ask for a Papa, Pops or Opa version.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Pickleball Grandpa design with two paddles and the line Dinking since retirement on a forest green tee.
